info.description:
This is a MongoDB Backend reflector server. Supporting front-end only application to deploy their own backend via PAAS platform to transmit their database data.

**Extended JSON**: use {"$oid": "..."}, {"$date": "..."}, {"$numberDecimal": "..."} etc. anywhere in query, documents, update, pipeline or options to send real BSON types. Add "responseFormat": "ejson" to any request to receive results in Extended JSON.

**Access keys**: if the server sets ALLOW_PUBLIC_USE=false, every POST needs an unexpired key from ALLOWED_KEYPAIRS in the X-Api-Key header (or Authorization: Bearer <key>); otherwise 401.

**Errors**: always JSON: { acknowledged: false, message, code?, codeName?, status?, timestamp }.
